raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

MiniMax H3's full-loop denoising stage rejects out-of-tree platforms because its platform allowlist only includes CUDA, HIP, CPU, MPS, NPU, and XPU.

This prevents out-of-tree backends from reaching the denoising loop, even when they provide the required device APIs and operators.

## Modifications

- Accept `current_platform.is_out_of_tree()` in the full-loop denoising platform check.
- Update the error message to include out-of-tree platforms.

This change removes the platform gate for out-of-tree backends. Each backend remains responsible for implementing the required operations.

## Testing

Tested on `<4687bb92b7ed6fad5cd2d11350b90b8f1bd6c6b6>`:

```bash
SGLANG_DIFFUSION_PLATFORM_OVERRIDE=cpu PYTHONPATH=python \
python -m pytest -q \
  python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_minimax_h3_denoise_loop.py
```

Result: 11 passed, 18 warnings.

Added a regression test verifying that an OOT platform passes the
platform check when all built-in platform predicates are false.
Confirmed that removing the OOT condition makes this test fail.

+def test_full_loop_accepts_out_of_tree_platform():
+    """Accept OOT platforms without loading a model or accessing hardware."""
+
+    class DeviceLookupReached(Exception):
+        pass
+
+    platform = Mock()
+    for kind in ("cuda", "hip", "cpu", "mps", "npu", "xpu"):
+        getattr(platform, f"is_{kind}").return_value = False
+    platform.is_out_of_tree.return_value = True
+    platform.get_local_torch_device.side_effect = DeviceLookupReached
+    stage = MiniMaxH3DenoisingStage.__new__(MiniMaxH3DenoisingStage)
+
+    with (
+        patch.object(denoising, "current_platform", platform),
+        patch.object(denoising, "_resolve_full_loop_context"),
+        pytest.raises(DeviceLookupReached),
+    ):
+        stage._run_full_loop(None, None)
+    platform.get_local_torch_device.assert_called_once_with()
